name: Work-from-home request
description: Ask to work remotely for a day or a period.

fields.label: To (leave empty for a single day)

subject: Work-from-Home Request: {{from}}{{#to}} to {{to}}{{/to}}
body:
Hi {{recipient}},

I would like to request permission to work from home {{#to}}from {{from}} to {{to}}{{/to}}{{^to}}on {{from}}{{/to}}{{#reason}} due to {{reason}}{{/reason}}.

I will be available online during my regular working hours, will attend all scheduled meetings, and will ensure that my deliverables are not affected.

Please let me know if this is acceptable.

Thank you,
{{sender}}
